description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Ice 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Revived Discipline Mode] and Ice Frenzy +1 to the user

description.name: Ice Explosion
description.text: Six single attacks (0.86/0.89/0.92/0.95 each) scaling with activations, 25%/50%/75%/100% additional critical chance scaling with activations

description.name: Sleet Supremacy
description.text: One single attack (6.00) capped at 99999, sets the user's HP to 1 if the user has Ice Frenzy level 1, grants [Instant Cast 1] if the user has Ice Frenzy level 1, causes Ice Frenzy -1 to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Revived Discipline Mode
description.text: Restores HP for 100% of the user's maximum HP and grants [Instant ATB 3] and [Instant Cast 3] when HP fall below 20%, removed after triggering

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
